question.problem: Find all values of $c$ that satisfy the mean value theorem for integrals for  $f(x)=2{x}^{2}+10$ on the interval $[-2,4].$
question.worked_solution:
Applying the mean value theorem for integrals, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(c)(b-a) & ={\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\ f(c) & =\frac{1}{b-a}{\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{4-(-2)}{\int }_{-2}^{4}2{x}^{2}+10\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{1}{6}\cdot (\frac{2{x}^{3}}{3}+10x)|}_{-2}^{4} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}[(\frac{2\cdot {4}^{3}}{3}+10\cdot 4)-(\frac{2\cdot (-2)^{3}}{3}+10\cdot (-2))] \\  & =\frac{1}{6}\cdot 108 \\  & =18.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the expression for $f(x)$ to solve for the value of $c:$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(c) & =18 \\ 2{c}^{2}+10 & =18 \\ {c}^{2} & =4 \\ c & =\pm 2\end{aligned}
$$
